mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle that lowers discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases corporate profit margins and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending and business investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 110), a sustained increase in industrial production signals robust output growth that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 110 and rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past month signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending boom regime (RSAFS > 350000), a rising retail sales figure signals strong demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below its 3-month moving average signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 3-month moving average and UNRATE is below its 3-month moving average.
